What kinds of packages are there?: What kinds of packages are there?
Every package has a tier (Pearl, Gold or: Every package has a tier (Pearl, Gold or Diamond) and a style (Classic, Modern, Vintage or Romantic). The package page shows the shoot length, the number of edited photos, and whether an album, a dress, and hair and makeup are included.
Each package is published by a studio wi: Each package is published by a studio with a La Memoria studio account. The studio's page shows all of its packages and photos.
How do I find a package that suits us?: How do I find a package that suits us?
On the Packages page, choose a tier, a l: On the Packages page, choose a tier, a location and a style in the sentence at the top. More filters lets you set a price range, the shoot length and the number of edited photos.
Which cities are there packages in?: Which cities are there packages in?
Seoul, Busan, Incheon, Daegu, Gyeongju,: Seoul, Busan, Incheon, Daegu, Gyeongju, Gwangju, Chonju, Daejon and Jeju.
Can I save packages to compare later?: Can I save packages to compare later?
Yes. Tap the heart on a package and it a: Yes. Tap the heart on a package and it appears under Liked in My Page.
What should we compare before choosing?: What should we compare before choosing?
The studio's photos and style, the shoot: The studio's photos and style, the shoot length, the number of edited photos and what is included, such as an album, a dress, and hair and makeup.
How do we reserve a package?: How do we reserve a package?
Log in, open the package, choose a date,: Log in, open the package, choose a date, add a note for the studio if you like, and send the request. Sending a request is free.
How will we know our reservation is conf: How will we know our reservation is confirmed?
The studio confirms or declines your req: The studio confirms or declines your request. Follow the status under Reservations in My Page: Pending, then Confirmed, and Completed after the shoot.
Yes. You can cancel a pending or confirm: Yes. You can cancel a pending or confirmed reservation under Reservations in My Page.
How far ahead should we reserve?: How far ahead should we reserve?
Popular dates, such as spring and autumn: Popular dates, such as spring and autumn weekends, are taken first, so it is best to send your request early.
Can we bring our own dress or makeup art: Can we bring our own dress or makeup artist?
The package page shows whether a dress,: The package page shows whether a dress, and hair and makeup are included. If they are not, ask the studio in your reservation note.
When will we receive our photos?: When will we receive our photos?
Each studio sets its own delivery time. Ask the studio in your reservation note.
What if there is a problem with our shoo: What if there is a problem with our shoot?
Talk to the studio first. If you cannot: Talk to the studio first. If you cannot sort it out together, call us and we will help.
You pay the studio directly. Nothing is: You pay the studio directly. Nothing is charged on La Memoria when you send a reservation request.
Does La Memoria charge couples a fee?: Does La Memoria charge couples a fee?
No. Browsing, liking packages and sendin: No. Browsing, liking packages and sending reservation requests are free.
Payment and refunds are agreed with the: Payment and refunds are agreed with the studio, so ask the studio about them before your shoot.
How do we join as a studio?: How do we join as a studio?
Sign up and choose Studio as the account: Sign up and choose Studio as the account type, then complete your studio profile in My Page.
How do we publish a package?: How do we publish a package?
In My Page, choose Add package, fill in: In My Page, choose Add package, fill in the details, add up to five photos and publish it.
Can we edit or pause a package?: Can we edit or pause a package?
Yes. Under My packages you can edit, pau: Yes. Under My packages you can edit, pause, publish or delete a package. Paused and on-hold packages are hidden from couples.
How do we manage reservation requests?: How do we manage reservation requests?
Requests appear under Reservations in My: Requests appear under Reservations in My Page. Confirm or decline each request, and mark the shoot completed afterwards.
How many photos can a package have?: How many photos can a package have?
Up to five. The first photo is the cover: Up to five. The first photo is the cover couples see in the lists.
How are packages and studios ranked?: How are packages and studios ranked?
Rankings are updated every night. A pack: Rankings are updated every night. A package ranks by its likes and views. A studio ranks by its packages, posts, likes and views.
How do we take part in the community?: How do we take part in the community?
Log in to write a post, comment and like: Log in to write a post, comment and like posts. Posts are grouped into Free talk, Recommendations, News and Humor.
Keep posts about wedding photos and prep: Keep posts about wedding photos and preparations, be kind to other couples and studios, and do not share anyone's personal details. Posts that break these may be removed.
What should we do about spam or abusive: What should we do about spam or abusive posts?
Call us and tell us which post it is, an: Call us and tell us which post it is, and we will review it.
How long can a post be?: How long can a post be?
A title can be up to 50 characters and a: A title can be up to 50 characters and a post up to 250 characters, including photos and formatting.
